marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 有人衣青衣 | You Ren Yi Qing Yi

I was born with yin and yang eyes, and I can see things that others cannot, so I am often approached by spirits who want me to redress their grievances. After the ‘lamp post’ incident, I got to know a policeman, Tie Zhu. Now, not only do I have to help the souls to redress their grievances, but also Tie Zhu will come to me when he encounters any strange and bizarre cases. This is not, the metropolis has occurred one after another blood-sucking zombie murder cases, making people panic. It is said that in ancient times, there were indeed four major zombies - Shogun, Drought Demon, Winning Hook and Houqing. The only blood-sucking zombies were the Shogun and its offspring. Soon after I intervened in the investigation, tragedy struck - a noodle shop girl I knew, Hachi, had her blood sucked by a zombie before my eyes. But when Lingmo and I captured the zombie and returned, Hachi's body disappeared...
